quotes.text: Dear and well-beloved brother Brigham Young, verily thus saith the Lord unto you, my servant Brigham, it is no more required at your hand to leave your family as in times past, for your offering is acceptable to me ; I have seen your labour and toil in journeyings for my name. 1 therefore command y6u to send my word abroad, and tako special care of your family from this time, henceforth, and…

I feel as though God was vexing this nation n little, here and there, and I feel that the Lord will let Brother Brigham take the people away. Here, in this city, lay my dead; my husband and children ; and if so be the rest of my children go with you, (and I would to God they may all go,) they will not go without me; and if 1 go.
